printed_header: The Civil Defense Department remained very active during the year. Although staffed with volunteer personnel only, in 1968 the department contributeda total of 670 man-hours. Such civic responsibility saved the Town $1,375.00and represents the deep concern of the faithful volunteers to the citizens. The Civil Defense Director maintains constant communications with the State Agency and through meetings and lectures obtains valuable knowledge on emergency techniques for the personnel. The largest capital equipment purchase made by the Town during the year was the Rescue Wagon. Approximately one-half ($6,500.00) of the cost of this vehicle will be reimbursed to the Town through the Civil Detense matching fund program. In addition, surplus property valued at $1,200.00 was purchased through the Civil Defense program at an actual cost of $42.00 | Civil Defense Director Rudolph Masella
